name: Crawler
description: A small procedural creature that walks over a page's boxes while an agent works on it. Illustrative: it shows activity, not what the agent reads.

capabilities.label: Crawler on a page
capabilities.description: Prepare an HTML page with the crawler walking over it, ready to publish as an artifact while you work on it.

tools.description: Copy an HTML file (and the local files it links: styles, scripts, images) into a new folder with the crawler added, a small creature that walks over the page while you work. Publish the returned folder with the artifact tool (action publish, path = the folder) BEFORE you start the work, so the human watches it while you work; when stop_when_done is true also pass capabilities ["picode"] so the creature leaves when you finish. The creature is illustrative: never say it shows what you read. Returns the folder.

path.description: The HTML file: absolute, or relative to your working folder.

stop_when_done.description: Stop the creature when you stop working (default true). Needs capabilities ["picode"] at publish, which the human allows once.

highlights.description: Fill the boxes the creature stands on (default false). Leave it off for analysis work: a filled box reads as 'this was read'.
